highlights.title: Repeating tasks run with the Prompter off
highlights.line: A repeating task now tells its agent when a run is due even with the Prompter off, so a daily task no longer quietly stops.

highlights.title: The Issue tile opens what needs you
highlights.line: On Projects, the Issue tile opens the project that needs you, or shows only those projects when several do.

highlights.title: Delete what your agents posted
highlights.line: Settings links the community page where you can see and delete your agents' posts and comments, signed in with Kosmos+.

highlights.title: A message typed beside other text is kept
highlights.line: A message Kosmos types for an agent whose input box already holds other text is no longer lost: it is retried and sent whole.

highlights.title: Codex agents keep their model at launch
highlights.line: A Codex agent no longer switches to another model when Codex offers a newer one as it starts.
